text:
I am not vegetarian or vegan, my friend is, when he came to town, we stopped here before going to the brewery across the way.

Having little to no experience with vegetarian food, I can say the chicken parm and Reuben sandwiches, along with the soups were second to none. Top notch quality and service.

I can't believe this place has been here 9 years and I've never been. I heard they had the "most amazing grilled cheese sandwich" in town (or maybe it was in the world?) so I couldn't wait to try it. Definitely NOT disappointed. The only down side was I wa Ted to try EVERYTHING on the menu and ... we'll ... I've only got one stomach. For me, it's a perfect place. Small, cozy, NO TV's, unbelievable food, wines, beers ... and did I mention the food? OMG! To die for. Their little side salad that comes with their meals is seriously the best salad I've ever eaten and I can't wait to just order it all by itself. Soooo good!!!
Pretty pricey for a whole lot of average seasoned proteins. Drinks were fine but the salad bar selection was lacking. Not somewhere I would go again. Worth a one time try to find out.

I ordered a 6oz filet mignon for a takeout dinner through DoorDash and it made my day on that busy Thursday! 
I chose to pick up by myself and it didn't take long when the food was ready. When I arrived, everyone was wearing masks and it was smooth and social-distant to get my packed items. 
The meal includes bread and butter, a starter between salad and cheese&cracker, the beef, French fries, and a dessert. It's definitely too much for me and it's so considerate that they are packed with a guide on how to re-heat each item properly to keep the taste!

Food is good and service is fast but the place is dirty. I feel like I'm dirtier after eating here and to be fair I've eaten here many times. One of the servers has long thumb nails and his thumb sometimes touches the soup when he's serving. Not very appetizing.

I've been going to Charley's from day one the employee turn over is not good last 2 to 3 months my drinks were not made right a lot of the times some of the bartenders were drunk.  the parade night my first drink was wrong i was told drank all day at parade. it kept getting worst one employee was sober i tried to let her make my drinks. one of drunk bartenders tried to give me a drink in a big plastic cup, not the regular cup. i called her bitch because i was so upset. management was out of town. next time i went door man said cant come back for 6 months. don't want to ever go back. they have cameras to show the big glass she pored it out in front of me in garbage can and said i am the manager. i will do what i want to. i wish them both the best. lots of people sent drinks back that night.

We sat at the bar and I may have found my new favorite bartender! Sam was so nice, she overheard me saying my throat was sore so she surprised me with a cup of hot water, lemon, and honey! We got the Bougie Palmer, Moscow Mule, and the Queso Fundido. It was all so good, can't wait to go back!

Do not, do not, do not eat here. Go elsewhere.

  I am usually pretty forgiving having worked in the food industry for years, but this place is just not worth the hassle.

Due to covid-19 you order by numbers that you write down on a piece of paper.  They did not bring our order not just once, or twice, but four times.  We waited 40 minutes for sushi. The waitress came over several times and repeated the sushi would be ten minutes, over and over.

We watched as other parties were served their food and we waited for food that did not come.  

We had two menus and the numbered items were different between the two, so on one number 62 was for example cheesecake while on the other a puff pastry or something like that. An entire section of the menu was like this and when we asked the waitress which menu was right apparently she was wrong, because we got totally different food than we ordered.

When we were checked on the waitress was telling us we were ok, instead of asking.  She would say you guys are ok and move right on. And when we tried speaking with her sadly the language barrier kept her from understanding most of what we said.

The table closest to us got alot of attention because they kept getting the wrong food.  I am pretty sure they were getting the food we ordered four times. The waitress repeatedly kept going back to them and asking which numbers they ordered.

They came and dropped the check off while we were still eating and waiting on other food that never came.

We love going to Syberg's we used their get in line app as usual. We got there in plenty of time, 20 minute wait, to check in as we are supposed to. When we got to the counter to check in the person could not find our in line check in. We showed her our text saying we were in line but she said nope not in the system. We gave her our name and also phone number from where we got the text and still nope not in system. We should of  had a 20 minute wait but since we are not in the system she would add us but it would be a 45 minute wait. We said nope! We drove to Joey B's to eat and half way there guess what! We got a text our table is ready, but we are not in the system! Very poor customer service by this young lady. We frequent here very often, but maybe not anymore!

It has been MANY years since I have eaten here, since before it was sold to the current owners. I was in the mood for some REAL pizza (sorry Pizza Hut and Dominos!) and started researching local pizza spots. After doing some research I found out it was #nationalpizzaday and decided to check this place out again. I was delightfully please to see that their pizza is still as fantastic as ever and nothing had changed. I even had to try their bread sticks after reading all the Yelp reviews because they sounded wonderful. Needless to say they did not fall short and completely satisfied! Pro tip: make sure to get an extra side of their Mornay sauce. You may want to dip everything in it!

Food was good- ordered thin crust pizza, salads and meatballs for delivery.  Delivery in reasonable time.  
However the delivery person did not wear a mask.   I live in a retirement community and have relatives that didn't survive the virus.  No excuse for not wearing a mask for delivery.  Without assurances I can't order delivery again from them

They close a wee bit early due to the COVID19 pandemic - 4 PM as of 3/28. 

Excellent customer service from the staff during these extreme times, I really enjoyed the "OMG" Sandwich - traditionally with chicken breast, jalapeno, tomato, red onion, greens and a delicious dijon-mayo spread on a soft roll. However - I subbed for their roasted turkey breast (as I prefer sliced over 'breast/chunk' on my subs). 

Very good flavor, I loved their unique wine and 'market' offerings/selection. Wines are reasonably priced with a description that both the average or wine-connoisseur could appreciate. 

I will be back.

My oldest and dearest took me here for my birthday, as our 'go to' Indian cuisine is take out only, amidst the 'Rona. 
Goodness, I suspect we have a new 'go to'! Staff was wonderful. Food was fabulous. Everything about the visit was fantastic. 
Fried Cauliflower was an excellent start, medium spiced. Garlic Naan executed perfectly. The two of us split a whole Tandoori Chicken & Lamb Biryani. I'm so pleased. They've totally surpassed my expectations and managed their attention to the 'Rona with great care and consideration. 
I look forward to tasting more from the menu. Maybe, we'll go extra spicy next time. Mmmm...

This is my go to for pizza in Cherry Hill. They have an abundance of toppings as well as crust options. (gluten free and cauliflower base). This would be great option for vegans/vegetarians as they have a lot of veggie topping as well as dairy free cheese and sauces. The pizza comes out crispy. Wait time is consistently very short so it's great for a quick bite. Would definitely recommend. Theg have a nice selection of lemonade and fancy iced tea that's worth checking out. 

Would definitely recommend if you're in the mood for pizza.

I am very very very disappointed with the way I was treated last night. I walked into ballpark village with my friends (we go there just about once a week), and we have no problems. That wasn't the case for last night. They took away my REAL ID, just because they thought I looked young and that it was a false documentation. Now I have to go back to the DMV and buy a whole new id and explain this situation. If you're actually 21 but still look young, I don't recommend coming here, unless you want to risk getting your ID taken. Worst part is, the security guard walked us all out and told us we can have my parents pick up my ID in the morning. I haven't talked to my parents in who knows how long, and they don't live with me. EXTREMELY disappointed with this whole situation. I will not recommend it to ANY of my friends as I've done in the past. Moral of the story, workers are very very rude and don't know how to spot a fake ID from a real ID.

Have been here multiple times but tonight was so frustrating. I had to get a manager to get our drinks 18 minutes after we sat down. The waitress was more worried about a table that came in after me. We went about 10 minutes without someone coming to our table to offer meat. It took 20+ minutes to settle the Bill - we had a discount code and I had to send it back twice because the waitress kept forgetting. We seemed to be on a side of the restaurant that didn't get the preferred service. I hope they get it back to how this restaurant used to be.

To be honest this was my second attempt (1st attempt was at a completely different restaurant) at Indian food in the past FOUR years! I'm not typically a fan of various shades of sauces over meat, but India Cafe was the group pick for today's lunch and I thought since it had been awhile I'd give it another go... I started by sampling a lil of (almost) everything on their buffet to see what I liked. To my surprise I really liked the Chicken Tikka Masala over rice. While this was my only win from the buffet they other nine people I was with enjoyed ALL of the buffet. 
We were greeted with smiles, quickly seated and received prompt service. The overall experience was good, and why I gave a 4-star rating. While I will probably not return my co-workers are already planning their next visit. If you enjoy Indian food this Cafe is worth adding to your list.
Including tax the lunch buffet was $11.98

Showed up tonight to order some takeout and absolutely loved it! The girl's at the counter were happy and cheerful... the food same out promptly... I got him to find everything I could want or need having been added to the bag and my order correct... and is was completely yummy! I had kung pao shrimp and a side of crab wontons. I will definitely be back here.

Stopped in for lunch and had an amazing time! We enjoyed the happy hour (2pm - 6pm) beers and lunch menu, and will definitely be back to check out the dinner menu. Our bartender, John, was super friendly and knowledgeable. The coffee was so good we had to get a bag to go. Highly recommended!

I have been here 2 times for breakfast with my wife. Everything we have ordered has been awesome. Pancakes, hash browns, bacon, toast, biscuits and gravy and even the coffee. And to top it off everyone there is very nice. Service is great too. Recommend to anyone to try this place. Can't wait to go again.

Over priced for the quality and proportion of food. 1 hour wait for our food (banquet party of 30 was sat at the same time as us and "everyone is trying to go to a show"). 
Since they are located at Westport you would think they would have figured out the pre-show rush. That being said it should not take 1 hour to get our food. I was told 45 min is typical?!
The waiter was nice at least. 
The only highlight was their toasted ravioli

Incredible! Everything from the service to the food and wine suggestions were done perfectly. Great escape from the madness of Bourbon street. If you are looking for the great NOLA cuisine you have heard so much about Bayona is it!

Our waitress was the issue. We waited over 25 minutes for rolls while she decided to get a party of 15 that showed up 15 minutes after we did. How is a party of 15 allowed during this pandemic? Kids are running wild and screaming. When did this turn into the mcdoanlds play center?

The mango dessert was good. Had a little bit of grapefruit in it which was nice. Was definitely very refreshing. Service was good. Ive had better matcha crepe cake elsewhere something about it tasted very bitter and had a specific taste to it. I think it was the matcha powder used. I have also tried the Oreo crepe cake and I would say that one is much better that the green tea cake.
First time here and salad and diablo steak pasta are amazing! Salad completely fresh and very good price for what it is!. Excellent customer service!

I came back after a long break and was delighted to find that it's still my favorite sushi spot in Tampa. The restaurant has excellent safety and social distancing policies too. They have a temperature check at the front door. All of the booths have plexiglass dividers between them. The staff is masked and gloved at all times. The menu is completely online. 

And let's not forget the food. The spicy tuna salad has beautiful chunks of tuna with a great kick, atop wakame and cucumber to cool. The crazy ninja is always a star. The bahama cruise is like dessert; the coconut shines through wonderfully. It's an excellent palate cleanser between spicy bites.

Food was decent quality but I didn't like some of the flavors on the Chicken Motiga(?) that I got.  The atmosphere is good but it is a little pricey and overall for my first time it was just average.  I will say that the service was very good.   A lot of people rave about this place so I'll come back and try a steak next time maybe but first impression was just ok.
I am a weekly regular. I sometimes come a couple of times a week. Especially now with the weather getting colder. The noodles, down to the broth and egg are amazing,

Love love!!! I can eat here everyday!! The seasame chicken is REAL white meat chicken fresh and hot. I look forward to trying the other items on the menu! My only go to for Chinese food; staff was nice and quick; prices are reasonable and many food choices

Great food.  Was thinking it's going to be just another burger place, but it's so good.  Had the Shack Stack and the Chik'n Shack.  Shack was so good.  Never thought about putting fried mushrooms on a burger, but this thing was great.  The bread was good and soft.  Wife said the Chicken Shack was great, loved the bun and the sauce was good.  Definitely recommend t hot spicy cheese fries also.

Went for lunch. Every time I go to this location, poor service or no service. Waited for menus, waited on food that some got and the rest got it when half were finished meal. Uncooked and burnt. I love Earls but honestly this location always disappoints. Unfortunate. Funny enough - talked to a few ppl and they felt the same. Had to actually call upon another waitress waiting on a different table because ours disappeared for very long periods. 10 min before menues, another 15 for water and 20 for apple juice! We had children with us. One didn't even get his pizza until the rest ate all the meals and even then the one waitress actually cleared the table before the kid got his meal! Not cool

I use to come here all the time like clockwork and the food was really good 5 star good the whole & party wings was great the rice bowls was great everything was...

But as of late I don't know what happened but i see a lot of new faces behind the counter. makes me think it's new owners which is not a problem if the food doesn't suffer but it has... I always get wings cus they are usually really good I called and asked for light seasoning and fried soft I get my order and the wings are super salty and fried hard this the third time...

Also I don't know who is answering the phones now but they don't seem to understand simple orders or request. It's too bad cus this use to be my go to spot.. hopefully they can tighten up and get things back in order.

Love Sushi Valley! Sushi is fresh and the service is friendly. We ordered the Oro Valley Roll, Nogales roll, Pink Lady, Spicy Tuna and spicy scallops, salmon & shrimp roll- all delicious.  They remain OPEN now for delivery and carry out. Please support them as a wonderful local restaurant especially during this time.
HIGHLY RECOMMEND. I've ordered here on several occasions. Always amazing. I get the falafel wrap.
I can not wait for them to open back up.  Best freaking soup dumplings.  On par with Din Tai Fung.
Excellent food, service and ambiance. The three main things you need from a restaurant. I'm not vegan, but this restaurant changed my whole concept. I'm returning!
Delicious food! Every time I go it's never a disappointment.  I definitely recommend for your next burger stop and the homemade fries are delicious as well.

I was in town for a conference near the convention center and ended up walking down to The Heights Public Market on two different nights with some of my fellow conventioneers.  It was about a 30-40 minute walk down the Riverwalk, which was beautiful.  We went twice because I was super impressed by the design and concept of the Market.  It was like an upscale, adult food court.  

The second night, I ordered from Hemingway's, a Cuban restaurant.  I tried the La Frita Cubana, which I thought was going to be a sandwich with sliced meats.  It turned out to be like a burger, made from chorizo, pork, and beef.  Still, it was tasty.  It came with a side, and I chose yucca fries because I love them.  It was all-around yumminess.  

It was totally worth the beautiful stroll down the Riverwalk to keep returning to this gem of many dining and drinking options.

Unfortunately, this evening my party of four had a VERY unpleasant experience at this establishment. Before our visit, we checked their website and menu for specials. We found the drink and food specials located on their website's menu below. However, when we received the bill, everything was priced at normal menu value (approx. $12 worth of savings). When approaching our waiter and then manager, we were told their menu had changed due to COVID-19. While I understand that menu's have changed, there was no mention on their website of any menu changes. According to the manager and waitress, WE should have ALSO checked their FACEBOOK page for an updated menu. While trying to come to a full understanding of why they could or would not honor the deal, both the waitress and manager became INCREASINGLY AGGRESSIVE until it reached a borderline hostile level. Then, when continuing to ask the manager so that I could fully understand the situation, she WALKED AWAY while I was STILL ATTEMPTING to CONVERSE WITH HER. Thoroughly unimpressed with how my party was treated tonight; I will not be back to this establishment. (Rating due to treatment of customers, NOT being upset about the $12 that wasn't saved.)
Best bang for your buck in SB. Their beef bowl is delicious. I get it delivered and it's always on time

Hands down my favorite walk in. Grilled onions. The hot sauce and the bags with radish's are fantastic. The tres leches is amazing even though it's from the bakery you get lucky enough to try it at 4. The staff is hit or miss but the food is totally worth it and the prices really aren't that bad. I miss tacos from Chicago and this is the closest I've come to getting them.

This was our first time at this establishment. We were quickly seated and able to start ordering right away. It was quite spacious and clean. 

I got Mala Spicy Soup- Chung King Style, which was flavorful and quite spicy (usually I can handle med-hot). My partner got Spicy Soup-Szechuan Style and it was more lighter but still had some spice. 

There was a lot of options for seafood including: crab, mussels, clams, fish and shrimp. There was only a few beef and lamb options. Other protein were frog legs, tofu, sausages, and eggs. 

Plenty of veggie options: bok choy, multiple mushrooms, spinach, broccoli, kale, radishes, seaweed, tomatoes, corn, etc. 

There was a nice sauce bar that you can pick and choose to enhance your meal. Also the ice cream bar included Klondike bars, ice cream sandwiches and ice cream bars. 

Overall we really enjoyed our experience and will definitely be back. The staff was super friendly and made it better!

This is the ONLY place to eat during COVID. Pima county health has certified their operations, requiring masks and temps. The chefs wear then too which brings comfort. The pizza us excellent-especially the White garlic one. New addition shrimp App is great.
Not bad I like how they give fresh chips and salsa, however the tacos were made with flour tortillas not corn so missed that authenticity

Okay so today I was treated to a wonderfully authentic Italian lunch of lasagna and tiramisu! My sister who lives in Italy was with me along with two more members of my family. Compliments to the chef! The food was amazing!!!! I plan to go back for Carbonara before I go back to Colorado

We found Fiamme's Pizza through a Yelp search of wood fired pizza. We are so glad we did. It was one of two best pizza's we ever had. We ordered the Carne plus mushrooms and the quality of the products were the best we've had. 
We feel very bad that we ate the entire pie in two sittings between just the two of us. It was that good !!!
We visit Tucson every 1-2 years and  we will certainly be back.

Indian food cravings have been satisfied.  Spicy, yummy aloo matar and fresh garlic naan for dinner.  I ordered carry out though I usually would eat there.  My food was ready in 15 minutes.  The owner was working the front of the house.  Polite as always.  If you are in the neighborhood, check this place out.
This place is some of the best Indian I've ever had. And the service is amazing.  It's a small spot but it delivers in terms of food!!!

i'm leaving four stars because i've been here twice. the first time my group had briana and she was amazing! she made the reforma experience so fun and made sure we had everything we needed. i cant give her enough praise, if you want a great experience please request briana as your server! she truly made our day. the second time was a little lackluster because our waitress was a bit cold. overall though, still a fun experience, love this place.

Decided to come in with our friends while our shopping. It wasn't that busy today and they do have every other table available for dine in as well as outside seating available upon request. They've turned 1 whole side of their parking lot into outdoor seating.  We were seated fast and got our drinks. They do have a very limited menu right now during COVID. So the veggie enchilada that I typically get I couldn't order as they don't have their veggie bundle available per the waitress. Even the tacos were served without veggies, only lettuce. So that was a bit sad but I opted for the Chicka Chicka Boom Boom which is a chicken enchilada with a spicy cheese sauce on top. This is served with rice and refried beans and boy was it delicious although spicy. We also ask for the Ranchero sauce and the Jalapeño sauce to dip with our chips given that their salsa is so dang spicy. The waitress was good today, a bit slow but overall ok. She kept our drinks refilled. 

My friends food wasn't great -- they ordered the chicken tacos which also came with rice and refried beans. But their chicken was a bit pink inside which they just ate the pieces that were not pink and the beans were cold. We advised the waitress of the cold beans and she immediately brought out 2 hot bowls for them.

Just came  back to Tucson from Phoenix and our first stop was El Indio.  This is our favorite place to eat whenever we are hungry and I don't want to cook.  Always yummy with great friendly service and the place is clean, clean, clean.

Treat yourself.  Best tamales Ive ever eaten..... anywhere.

Best restaurant in Carmel! We enjoyed another great carryout tonight- again, the crab baguette is AMAZING. Food was hot, service prompt and as we picked up could see patrons eating in all spaced out, servers masked etc. We are so happy they continue to *hopefully* do well and stay in Carmel for a long time!

Literally the worst chipotle I've ever been to. We got there around 1-prime lunch hour and they were out of chicken, beans, fajita veggies and white rice. They told us it would be. 6-10 minute wait- we waited 20 minutes and the chicken was so burnt and disgusting. The rice was dry , the corn was soggy and I was a little mad that they weren't prepared for lunch hour but I was even more mad I waited and it was gross. And there was a huge deep puddle of water all down the waiting line and everyone's feet were wet and 3 people said something and the workers did nothing. Also my table was nasty.

The best Chinese food (with an upscale twist) that I have ever eaten. To start off, the cocktails don't only just look good, they also taste amazing! The bartenders here really know what they're doing. Stated off with a homemade egg-roll....but note that they are definitely way larger than your average so I would say that one is good for two people. A good mixture of vegetarian friendly and meat-lover entrées. Ordered 3 plates to try a little bit of everything. Hearty sized portions, which is great for a delicious reheat later if you decide to take leftovers home (which you should, do not waste this stuff, people!).  Service was good, not to little and not overbearing. These chefs know what they're doing so do yourself a favor and stop by!

Decided to try the place for the first time.  Messed my hip up so I went through the drive thru.  Got to the speaker only to be today by, I guess a recording that the drive thru was out of service and I would have to come in.  Drove around and saw a lady standing by the outside, she had been there when I first pulled into the parking lot.  I asked her if they were open, she said there were customers inside eating so yes.  She went to a side window and knocked, since no one payed attention to her knocking on the door.  A customers got up from a table and let her on.  At this point I decided screw it, not worth the hassle just to get lunch.  First and last time I will waste my time going there.

I think is by far one of the best beach front restaurants in Apollo beach. I got the crab legs as an appetizer which is always a great choice. For a meal i got the cob sandwich which was AMAZING, truly delicious. The view of the water is gorgeous. Perfect place for a date night.

Food is good but not great.  The beer is their own and very good.  The location is fantastic.  I went for dinner, but probably wouldn't do that again; the food wasn't worth what they charge.   For me it's a place to hang out have a few appetizers and beer on a sunny day.
Great place to visit with family ! Family owned and super friendly. Accommodating to the adults and the kids . The food was fresh and delicious! Would definitely visit again !!

Maggiano's is an Italian chain restaurant that offers a wide variety of pastas and Italian-American dishes. 

Nestled in the Westshore mall among other well known eateries, Maggiano's stands out for having hundreds of seats, function rooms and giant bar. Not to mention taste and value that should make you forget Olive Garden exists. 

The service here is top notch. They truly care for customers with allergies, as the chef will visit your table to discuss alterations. Our servers have always been amazing. Shout out to Megan.

The portions are huge. Gluten-free penne option. Select pasta purchases come with a FREE classic pasta to take home! Plus, they have a meal deal for two including soup, salad, meal and dessert. Worth it if you're super hungry. 

Minus one star because they changed some recipes since my last visit a year ago. I totally miss the mushroom risotto! Although, four stars for Italian food outside of my nanas kitchen is pretty generous.

Seafood chowder , pork chop,onion rings,calamari 5 stars and thumbs up ....our server Laura three stars seemed overwhelmed and silverware and refill of drinks where forgotten often.clean place everyone wearing mask and respectful of social distancing...will return

Yummy!!! This place was delightful. The pepper jelly with the biscuits was a culinary experience. So good!! They have some very unique coffee flavors. We tried the Thai basil latte. The food came quickly and was all incredible and fresh. The breakfast potatoes also were crispy and flavorful. I will also say this restaurant is handling COVID precautions well, asking you to keep your mask on until your food/drinks arrive and also keep on while ordering which I haven't seen enforced at other places. Well done! Great vibes, great food. Make sure you get there early or you'll be waiting for a bit,  worth the wait!

Soggy fries that taste burnt, the chicken tortilla soup is extremely greasy, with nasty chunks of dark grisly chicken. Everything is way over salted. The staff is very friendly and they make the best ranch dressing I've ever had though. I'd stick to their salads!

Wow! So good! Loved the spicy chicken with fried rice, such great flavor and texture and the sauce was amazing! Also, the lunch specials are very reasonably price ($7.50-$9.50) for a solid portion size. My wife who is normally hesitant to get Thai food loved it as well! We'll be coming back!
You want sauce, chick fil a got chu, you want fresh tasting chicken, this place got chu, want a nice milk shake or lemonade, this place got chu

Friends of mine know that I am a huge fan of korean fried chicken! From the original soho cafe in cheltenham to bon chon in Chinatown. I love trying them all, my waistline not sooo much but eh  with waker chicken gone from the HMart in cheltenham (still upset over this) this place in Chinatown is now my favorite. The seasonings are great, wings are always fresh and crispy on the outside and moist on the inside. Cute little place inside but I have only gotten taken out and even driving those wings 45 min or so home, they remained crispy when i got home. Tsaocoa is the bubble tea place that is pretty well known, has amazing teas and other drinks and BBQ is the chicken place. My favorites are the secret spicy and the soy garlic, both are a little on the sweeter side than other korean chicken places but still very good.

How have I not been here yet???  Holy Moly!!  YUM!!!

Ran out for an early dinner....glad we did because I bet this place gets packed!!

Super clean and decor was super fun. Right when you walk in there is a table with large menus so you can begin pondering your choices...the menu has tons of options. All options can be made as taco, burrito, salad, or nachos. 

We started with chips and guacamole. The chips are super fresh and plenty thick to hold up in the guacamole. Guacamole had large chunks of tomatoes and was wonderful. We also ordered the Tampa Bay Punch...a concoction of a frozen margarita and frozen sangria topped with a "baby" Corona. The punch was large enough to share....very refreshing. 

We ordered all tacos:

Ranger - BBQ pork with a spicy slaw, cheese, sour cream and jalapeño. 
Peacemaker - fried chicken BBQ sauce, spicy slaw and cilantro
3 Little Piggies - pork chorizo, seared pork, carnitas and bacon with pick and guacamole 
Federale - shrimp (grilled) with BBQ sauce, bacon, slaw and guacamole 

All were full of flavor and ridiculously fresh. Can't wait to come back and pick a few more to try. I also plan on trying the Mexican Street Corn and the Queso. 

Staff was super friendly and patient as we struggled with our decision. Meal was $38 - not terrible for all that we got. 

Thanks Capital Taco - I'll be back!!!!

I ordered two tiffin boxes for lunch today, one veg, one non-veg and they were delicious and were good portions.  We have enough for another meal.  Service and packaging were excellent; just ordered ahead and they brought it out to me when I arrived.  Highly recommend!

I'd been trying to get the spicy chicken sandwich for months back in NYC, without any success. So my last resort was to fly to New Orleans and go straight to the source. Oh, I guess I also had to go a wedding or something.

Anyway, the lines here can be daunting, but they move fast. Most everything is ready to go, and they have multiple registers.

The spicy chicken sandwich was good. Was it worth the hype? Probably not, since almost nothing is. But it was worth having.

By far, they are the best Chinese restaurant in Indianapolis. 

It was first time in three years and everything we had tasted good. 

Parking is convenient. 

Service is very good too. Waitress and the owner were very friendly.

I can't say the food was worth the price. The munchies basket was okay, the marinara sauce was subpar it was dry and lacked flavor. The wings were average luckily the ranch was top quality. However they only give you a small cup of it, I suggest providing ranch with the munchies box instead of the marinara sauce as it would make the food more enjoyable.

Cute little place by the canal 
Friendly staff. 
Food was good. Light and fresh. 
It's byob 
They have a few vegetarian options
Quantity is ok as quality is high
They are kid friendly

We have been in NOLA for for the past couple days and this restaurant had THE BEST food & THE BEST service that we have experienced since our arrival! We had Gumbo, oysters and wings for our appetizers. And we had étouffée , red beans, shrimp Alfredo and blackened alfresco for our entree's 
Everything we ordered was cooked to perfection & seasoned just right and our server Noel WAS THE BEST!!
She was VERY friendly and she made sure we never had an empty cup! I REALLY appreciate her kindness!! We will be back the next time we are in town!

This place used to be awesome. Tonight's takeout was a disappointment. They got my order wrong. Cant call to tell them  because their phone is constantly busy for the last 30min. Be sure and check your order closely before you leave. And the prices seem to keep going up while quality and quantity are going down.

I had the red curry chicken. My husband had the chicken teriyaki. Both were very good and I had leftovers. We really like the bento boxes here, especially the California rolls and egg roll. Their bubble teas are also very yummy. Their soda machine was out of Diet Pepsi on our visit, which is the only diet option. Overall, a good place to eat!
I absolutely love Yards. The tours are fun and informative and the atmosphere is perfect for catching up with friends over games and great beers (nothing beats the Philly Pale Ale).

Delicious food! Outdoor dining was seat yourself and comfortable. Dog friendly as well.

Definitely coming back here again the next time we are up in the SB region again!

I hadn't been to a TGIF in probably three years and now I know why - truly haven't missed anything-it was disgusting. I hadn't had red meat in like 2 mos I was craving a burger.  I went to Creve Couer location -I will never go back to that TGIF or any other. I did curbside and they forgot condiments, staff wasn't full so it wasn't ready in time either.  I pitched it -it was so nasty.
The WORST experience I have ever had. Will not be ordering from the restaurant going forward.
Ehhh not my ideal Mexican eatery however the service here isn't bad and neither is the guacamole  Maybe I'll give another try!
Delightful dinner venue.  Service is top notch. We had the porterhouse steak and salad.  It was beyond our expectations.  Perfect night.
25 minutes to get food, order was messed up, apple was rotten, server was surly and rolled his eyes when asked for a to go bowl. Overall yuck!

Best steak Stromboli I have ever had. Tomato pie was excellent. 
Service under these unusual conditions was outstanding. 
Will be ordering again soon.

I'm from out of town and was staying at a hotel nearby. This place is adorable, the food was great and very reasonably priced. In addition to the cute, cozy interior, they had a lovely outdoor patio where we could sit. I love that it's a family owned restaurant and they are doing a great job trying to run their business during these crazy times! Nonna's was a very pleasant surprise.

Worst Ihop I've ever been in. My server Jamie took forever to greet us and we were one of four tables.
The food took 40 minutes to come out and EVERYTHING WAS COLD AND DRY. When asked to remake, they microwave my burger and retried my fries.  Nothing was remade. Even the biscuits and gravy had a dry layer on the outside from sitting too long. The manager Kim came originally nice and offered another option and to take care of the bill. One friend of mine had food that was fine and she made no complaints, however when I said I rather not have anything and was ready to go my friend asked for a to go box and Kim responded with, why do you need a box if you didn't like it. It was rude and suggestive and I'll never be back. The server Jamie came by to take the plates and knocked a ranch cup in my friend's water, which she was still drinking. He didn't apologize and he never came back to the table. The worst food and worst service I've ever gotten at ihop.

Federal donuts has been a part of my lunch rotation since I started working in center city a few years ago. The chicken sandwhich is one of the best and the hot fresh cinnamon donuts are delicious. The chicken sandwich and those donuts are made fresh the moment you place the order. That means there is a wait, but the food is worth it. There is also a rotating selection of fancy donuts that u can grab immediately without a wait. Those donuts are good too, but I prefer the cinnamon donuts. Those fresh hot donuts are unique to federal donuts.

I must admit I am still mad, after years, that Federal donuts no longer makes their very best donut, the pumpkin spiced latte donut. They need to bring that back to jump up to a 5 star review.

They are very hard to find if you don't know your way around town or have time to drive around and the parking is terrible so I haven't been back I went once and somebody drop me off and then went and parked and then came back to pick me back up I'm not a young person you know the food was pretty good but parking is bad
Awesome and friendly staff. With super good natural menu options. Outdoor seating for COVID and Cute decoration.

I visited Bubba's 33 with my coworkers to celebrate a birthday. I wasn't expecting much since all I knew about it was that it was a concept by a restaurant that I don't visit because it is not vegetarian/vegan friendly. 

I was pleasantly surprised that they had some food my family could eat. I was even more surprised to find out that some things, like the veggie burger, appeared to have been made in house vs using a generic frozen veggie burger. The burger, which I took home to my wife, was made of black beans and quinoa. It was huge and lasted her a couple meals and was reasonably priced. On the side, I ordered some regular fries. I was thrilled that Bubba's 33 has a variety of fries including sweet potato, fire and tots. 

For my kids, I ordered some garlic knots and a pizza and grilled cheese. Those picky eaters ate all of it (though I think they enjoyed the knots the most).

Bubba's 33 was a pleasant surprise for my vegan/vegetarian family and I totally appreciate that. Decent food with giant portions and a great price tag.

Excellent Mexican food. The tacos de carne asada are perfect. Great prices too !  We have had the burrito de carnitas and the vegetarian burrito. Both excellent. Lived in LA for over 20 years and this is the closest I have found in Florida
Amazing food at a nice price ordered the Oreo Cookie Monster waffles and they were flawless. Definitely will be returning my next visit !
This place is heaven sent. Staff is quick, friendly, and fast. Food tastes great!! 10/10 would recommend.

Reall great entrees - we ordered the Panang Mole Burrito & the Chorizo Pad Thai and both were amazing. The Panang Mole comes with 2 BURRITOS and the pad thai portion was HUGE. We also got the Mexican street corn as an app which was really yummy as well.

The kitchen itself is rather small so prepare for a bit of a wait depending on when you go. Some people complained about waiting so long but we didn't really mind it, the atmosphere was fun and we ordered drinks and apps to hold us over. 

The only 2 negatives were the margaritas and the chips. The margs were just off and reaaaallly strong and the chips that came with the salsa tasted like chips from a football stadium. I honestly don't think we would have noticed but compared to how fresh the salsa and everything else we ate was, bagged chips seemed like a miss. 

All and all really great dinner and we are looking forward to going back!

O-M-G, I'm STILL thinking about the falafel plate, and I ate it 3 days ago. It was so delicious--3 perfectly crispy falafel balls on the most delectable flatbread (so much oily goodness!) I've ever tasted. It hit the spot. I don't live in Boise, so will need to return here on my next visit. I hope it's still on the menu! 
Other stuff: Great people watching opportunities if you eat outside (it's on their main drag downtown), prices are a little high but worth it, staff is super nice.

First timers, and man, are we impressed. From the service, to the drinks, to the food - everything was perfect. We had the french onion ring and sweet potato tot apps. Both were delicious and worth a trip on their own. For dinner, we had the chicken cordon blue handheld - loved it and the potato salad. Also for dinner, the Three Kings burger - also amazing. We will be back for sure!

And Danielle was the best server we have ever had, hands down!

Service started slow but the Shaking Crab was redeemed with delicious boiled shrimp and crawfish.  Chose the garlic butter and it did not disappoint.  Husband went with the shrimp basket. Large fried shrimp with Cajun seasoning.  Their homemade "cocktail sauce" really isn't the typical sauce. More like Cajun ketchup.  We will return.

It was very busy for take out order but it's hard to justify finding a plastic piece in my stir fried that I chewed on.

I do like the flavors of the foods but they can be very greasy especially the noodle soups, there's literally an inch of oil on the broth, and when I asked the waitstaff she told me it is how they prepare the broth so there's nothing she can do.

There should be a thin layer of hot oil, yes, but not an inch, never this over the top. Many ways to improve.

I lived in both Sichuan and Taiwan for years so I think I am more than qualified to give this judgment.

Excellent experience all around.  

First, the space.  It has a chic French feel without feeling stuffy or pretentious.  It's warm and inviting and bustling without being too loud.  Really really loved the vibe and the decor.  It feels very Paris, in the way that makes you want to come back again and again.

Drinks - delicious, well crafted.  Next time, I want to sit at the bar for drinks and dessert.  Loved the feel of the bar. 

Food - everything was delicious and beautifully presented.  Well balanced flavors in every dish.  We loved everything we ate.  Duck, scallops, Manila clams, hen of the woods mushrooms.  We didn't have time for dessert as our parking was expiring.  Definitely next time.

Serviced - we looooved our waitress.  Knowledgeable, friendly, fun.

I actually got to try them at the Carolwood tasting event and their BBQ was very good. What really  got my taste buds waterting was the coleslaw! And I'm not a fann of coleslaw whatsoever but it was the mix along with the pulled pork. Quite delightful.

I visited an Ichicoro venue while I was in Tampa at Armitron. By far the best Ramen spot I've visited. I ordered Shoyu with Pork belly. The broth was flavorful and the entree was well prepared and filling. They used garlic and scallions along with soy to flavor the chicken broth. I also ordered an unsweetened Matcha tea which was very refreshing and left no bitter after taste. I would visit this location again without a doubt!

Omg where do I start???? We was so excited to get an invitation to Our Neice 26 Birthday Party Dinner. At first we didn't know where it was but my niece text me and said at Benihana's and we said great. I was thinking we was going to the one in New Jersey. But unfortunately that location wasn't close to my neice. So we went to the one in Plymouth Meeting. We had a while to wait because because they were short. They was trying to seat everyone but some people didn't have reservations. So that made our wait longer then suppose to. The kids was getting restless and it was getting late. So finally we got our tables and were seated. Some of the staff was acting like bobbleheads all over the place. It took a good 20 minutes before the chef came to the table. They had one waiter waiting on six tables by his self. The waiter finally came to the table to ask us about drinks we didn't really look at the menu because we had to download it on iPhone it took a minute to get the information on some of the family members phones. So everyone finally Place their order it was plates on the table with napkins no silverware it took them a good 20 minutes for silverware so I made a comment. Do they have to wash and roll them we had our food but no silverware I know I'm jumping before but then the manager came out and was trying to help the waiter. The drinks came out late no one had water then finally the chef came out his uniform was dirty with food stains all over it he was cooking our food and

Good food! I tried their brisket and macaroni and coleslaw. The host was a little rude her name was Elizabeth. She kept talking to me like she didn't know what I was saying and had a very rude tone like she didn't want to be there. It's a shame they have nice BBQ but I'll have to reconsider coming back.

Food was really good and came out quickly.  The live band was talented (Duh, it's Nashville).  KYLA downstairs at the bar was a pleasure to talk with - excited about her job and personable. Thanks for making these Phoenix people feel welcome!

Had an enjoyable dinner here. Tucked away in the corner of a strip mall. The place was hopping and seemed popular. Not a fancy place, you can come casual.  It what's important is the service was good and the sushi, edamame and miso soup were all good. We walked in so not sure if they take reservations. There was a birthday near us and the staff was gathered around singing happy birthday- wished they had done it in Japanese :/

Had lunch at this Trainwreck Saloon on Manchester today, surprised to learn from the same mental woman (arm tatoos) that slams cups and glasses on the table they no longer offer deserts of any kind. I'm sure ownership will be surprised

I'm starting to realize a trend with my reviews and starting to think that downtown Boise does not have the same quality as restaurants that right outside Boise restaurants do. Service lacks big time as was the case here. In this case it was extremely slow. I ordered the pork chops and it was huge BUT it was alllll fat. I've never seen anything like it. The server suggested I order another one when this already turned my stomach. It took about 15 minutes for it to arrive. Of course my husband had finished his tacos which were ok. Forgot to mention we ordered chips and salsa as an appetizer, salsa good, chips stale and they charged you for chips and salsa. That's just silly. This chop wasn't as fatty but there was a significant amount. The side of pork and bean that accompanied the chop were just not good. The server could see I only took a few bites of my meal. In our opinion, the meal should have been comped since it came out in an inedible way, had to wait and not eat with my husband and the second one was not good. He took off half the price. In addition, the server was super slow and as we watched him he did not appear to have a sense of urgency for any of his tables. Do not think we'll be back. 
Quick update... I just learned they are the same owner of Bittercreek, makes sense now. See my sad review there.

Went to the one in the airport. I have never been to a Pei Wei before but I think it's kind of like an upscale Panda. Considering COVID and all, the place was relatively packed. I appreciate the fact that they have a full bar. I had a beer but considered ordering a Sidecar. I ordered the Mongolian Steak meal with brown rice and my wife ordered Kung Pao Chicken. The sauce, steak and green onion had a solid flavor. However, my food was cold. Also the meat quality was not great. I had some gristle bites and the steak was too chewy and not really that tender. My wife said her meal was "great." She also admitted that she doesn't care about the food temp as much as I do. Service was good, friendly and quick. 

Overall: meh...flavor was excellent but temp and steak quality were meh.

Who doesn't wanna have some food after a day at the beach?

8 of us came in to Brass monkey on Sunday at around 3 pm. We got separated into 2 tables because there was no wait this way, which we didn't mind. 

They have a BIG menu with a lot of items, and I actually think the menu is too busy with menu items stacking on each other. I think it would have been a nicer presentation if the menu was separated into 4 pages instead is 2 pages.

I got Patrick's burger, which was $10. The burger patty was very big, it came with mushrooms onions tomato and lettuce, as well as chips. However, I did not expect the "chips" to be a bag of potato chips. I personally don't really like Lays potato chips, so that was a turn off. 

Other than the chips, everything was good. The food was good, and the waitress was nice.

It's not much to look at but this bbq is on point. We stopped on the last leg of a looong road trip and the food here perked is right up. Every one of the 7 people in our group got something different and we ate every last bite. 

It does take a good amount of time to get your food so if you're in a rush, don't be fooled by the word express in the name. Otherwise, enjoy!
Simply good Buffett food at reasonable price. The local police eat  there which I generally find is a good i indicator of good food.

Stopped in for a beer to kill some time when I was passing through St. Pete and was sad to leave!! Friendly group of locals were hanging at the bar, they completely took me in with a warm Florida welcome. Beer selection is great. All the big staples, with several local beers thrown in. Bartender was awesome. Great place. Sad I had to leave.

The food was good, but the curbside experience gets 2 stars. Ordered food online for pick up and online said the sign had pick up instructions, but there was none. Googled and called, but it was an automated message. 

So decided to go in to pick up. Of course as I'm  heading to walk in 3 people that we're leaving the restaurant decided to block the entrance way for 2 of them to light up a cigarette. Are you kidding me? 

Then the lady with them decided to cough without covering her mouth right into my direction (thank God I had a mask). Even without a pandemic that's just a lack of manners and gross. The whole curbside experience was a mess.

Favorite beach restaurant. Live music, good pours on the drinks, and the food is tasty with good portion sizes. I love the beachside burger, Cuban sandwich, fish tacos, and the Cuban nachos. SO good. If you want a true sunset dinner, this is the place. No wild partiers; just people enjoying FL living.
Want your food done right ask for the new mgr Tony. He aims to please and is determine to get First Watch more consistent and deliver the things you love about this place.

Everything at this restaurant was top notch.  The servers were helpful and kind and didn't rush me at all. The specials for brunch were amazing. My favorite dish was hands down the biscuits and gravy. I'm from the south and know my way around biscuits and gravy, but this was next level good.  I wanted to order nine orders to go.. but I attempted to use some willpower.

So when you go, order the biscuits and gravy for me.
The beer was great. We didn't order food but they had a good menu. I'd definitely recommend stopping in if you're in the area.
The service was good, and the sushi was fresh and tasty. The ramen was a tiny bit on the bland side, but nothing a bit of soy sauce can't fix.

It's just a bar. BUT... its perfect and I love it. Nothing exciting here, just cheap beer and well drinks, lots of seating, and average ambiance. It's just a bar. Still, I love coming here to finish off a night out. It's not a destination - don't go out of your way to come here - but if you've been out in East Nashville and want to just end the night at a casual place with a cheap beer, this is where you should do it. I've been probably 3 or 4 times now and I've come to expect nothing more and nothing less than the no-frills, chill place that it is. Huge patio for hot summer nights and heat lamps to make it doable the rest of the year. Can't totally describe why I like this place so much when there's nothing really special about it, but if you come with low expectations and just want a place to chill with friends, you'll be happy you came!
Delicious soup, juice, and sandwiches. Everything was hot, fresh, and very reasonably priced for what you get.

The food is normally good but these people are idiots. I ordered a bacon, egg and cheese on a bagel. Instead I got some dried egg, bacon and cheese omelette on a bagel. Wtf???? Just make a dang sandwich u idiots. Was dry and disgusting. Oh and the bagel was wet. I'm done with these people

Great Dominican Bakery. Generally we are very weary of spanish bakeries because they skew to way too sweet. And me and Mrs. are both hispanic, we know. Ana's was everything we didn't expect. Sooo very cute inside, looks like an upscale cake shop. Loved the cookies with dulce de leche, the Majarete, the cakes and the tres leches was to die. Nothing was overly sweet. All the flavors came through brilliantly. Of course there were a couple misses like the dulce cortado and the chocoflan, they didn't impress. But everything else was great. Have been here 3 times in two weeks. Definitely recommend.

I love the Stone House. I think they need a better check-in system.  The food from the Breakfast through Happy Hour is wonderful.  The facility is clean and service is superb.  Plenty of outdoor seating. Dogs are allowed outside. They take cash or credit cards (not sure about checks).

This is my favorite breakfast joint!!!  We will keep coming back!

Breakfast sandwich - the egg dissolved in my mouth, I wouldn't call it an egg. Cold donuts, go to Krispy Kreme across the street for something more fresh and Starbucks across the parking lot for coffee

We visited the Indian Twist with a small group of friends last month. Just me - not a big fan of Indian food, but this has a different, more modern, vibe to it's food. The ones that like Indian food thought it was great. They take reservations - we had 12 people. Not too large of place, but they handled our group with no problem. We split the Chicken Tikka and Naan (which was my favorite). They do have quite a variety on the menu. For all those that like a modern Indian food - check this place out at Camp Lowell/Swan!

I went with my family to Carrabba's over the weekend and had a great experience.

The food was great.  Rob and the manager Sandy were very accommodating, professional and funny.

We'll definitely go back.

So many things I wanted to try here but we are in New Orleans so we only got to eat here once. The pizza is definitely the beat I've ever eaten. I was told that the roasted cauliflower and garlic knots are to die for but we didn't get a chance to order them. They have a great happy hour every day 3-6. Half price drinks and all pizzas. So good!

I'd rate it a zero if I could. I ordered online for delivery and it never came. I waited an hour to finally call to find out my order was cancelled when it was placed but was never updated. Just let me know and I'll move on. But they made me wait an hour to find out they just ignored my order. Horrible service.

Ordered online and went in for pickup. First I stood by the sign that said online orders.  Two other people walked straight and got there order.  So I tried the same and was ignored by the person up front.  Stood there patiently until I seen my name on the bag.  Had to ask for it.  Manager was out front as well and he could care less.
We got steamed dumplings as an app and seafood and pork pho as the meal. All were delicious. The pork was very well cooked and extremely flavorful.

Ribeye tacos!!!!! This little hole in the wall was such a pleasant surprise. The food was delicious and the service was good. Can't believe we didn't try this restaurant earlier.  We highly recommend:)
Great food, drinks and atmosphere. I forgot about this spot because we're rarely out that way, but it's always a great go-to when in the area.
A busy, loud bar type atmosphere with very good seafood.  I had the crab cakes and my wife the slider plate.  Crowded with a young professional set.  Enjoyed our dinner here.

I got one star off because there was no shade or any kind of umbrella for the outdoor dining. We were sweating all the time in the 97F degree, so it was pretty much painful to fully enjoy the meal under the burning sun.
Other than that, food was good. It was my first time to Green Eggs and I enjoyed my food selection. I had an Egg Benedict with roasted potato and bell peppers. The eggs were well done and the roasted potatoes were well seasoned.
For dessert, I ordered red velvet pancakes. The serving was huge my partner and I could only finished one fourth of the plate. The pancakes themselves are soft and fluffy, but there were not too much flavor in them. 
Next time coming back I would probably go for a dine-in opportunity. I would love to try other pancakes because they all looked so good when I saw them being served to other customers.
Great beer selection. Place is always busy which is a good thing. The menu options are the best and we especially like the mussels.
Ordered a shrimp plate using uber eats. I enjoyed it. I would order again. The shrimp were fried to perfection.

Best Vietnamese food in the tri-state area. Nothing else even comes close. Avocado shake and Viet cofefe are . Has food for people new to the culture but also very authentic food for the more outgoing. Summer rolls and pho broth 10/10. #1 on billboard with no radio

Hedge Row is an amazing experience. The food, the cocktails and the service is all top notch. I really appreciate how accommodating they were even though my party was late! You should come here at least once

I usually enjoy your guys turkey crossiant and avocado sandwich and the breakfast burrito. The salsa was missing for my burrito. For some reason you guys gave me cocktail sauce? I ate half of my food. I started to eat the fruit and than I saw mold.... on the blue berries. Unacceptable and disgusting. Now I know to never get fruit from you guys cause its obviously rotten.

Expensive for a breakfast spot in Tampa. They only scramble your eggs there is no option to do other wise. I wasn't impressed at all, not a lot of options, small menu and pastries are nothing like our pastries back home.

Take your pick from Thai, South American and several others. We had Poke bowls, very fresh, very good. Finished with  Rolled ice cream. Great stuff. This place is like a stand alone food court with full bar.
Good basic Breakfast place. Love that they understand and focus much on gluten-free. Wish they had the gf fried chicken that the corner pub has.

We had the best experience here at corners. Not only is the food fantastic but the service here is very delightful. Our server TINA is beyond the best. She suggested amazing food our favorite was the char broiled oyster! Definitely wanting to go back again.  We went to New Orleans for the weekend and didn't miss a chance to go back each day! Just to eat the delicious food and see our favorite waiter.

Seriously some of the best Chinese food I've ever had, have been coming here for years for lunch. They are open and need your support! They are doing all you can eat cafeteria style, disposable plates and Flatware. There is a guard between you and the food and when they seatbelt it they are masked and gloves up. Give it a shot!

I love this place. I want you to go there so it stays open. I don't want you to go there because I don't like waiting in line. All the muffins are amazing. I am not going to tell you my favorite because then you might go there and order the last one before I get there.

I have called once a day for six days to get an accidental extra charge on my card reversed. Honestly had a great time, even plan to come back but at this point I feel this is all I can do to get someone's attention. I have worked in hospitality roughly 12 years- I understand these mistakes are made but come on what's the hold up? Hopefully this message is read.. UPDATE** I have been told by the manager Jamie that he will not refund my card the $48 they took from me. Someone else that night got very lucky and left with a free bar tab compliments of me! Be warned if you go to this bar you may pay for someone else's drinks apparently. (This all comes after I made a total of 7 phone calls in 8 days trying to get this resolved). Couldn't be more upset with this bar.

Truthfully, I'd give them 3.5 stars, but I'm giving them the benefit of the doubt since it's not really my style. The Mill has a really strong following in St. Pete, but it doesn't seem to translate to Tampa (yet). Given their St Pete fans and being a new restaurant in South Tampa, I was really surprised it was just over half full when we walked in on a Saturday night at 7pm. In general, everyone seemed to like their food (the southern salad, the meatloaf Wellington) except for me, and I had the brussels sprouts salad. The main takeaway: Don't order a salad at an "elevated Southern" restaurant. 

The best part of the night? Our server was SUPER friendly and the valet left cookies in the car!

I heard about this place over and over. We heard their food was the BEST. The biscuits and gravy, to die for. Close... I'd rather die than eat here again. Although the restaurant was adorable and decorated nicely, the food had no flavor and my hubby swears that they used a sponge instead of a bisquit and a glue mixture for the gravy. We were just not impressed at all

I usually dont do poor reviews on service alone but service here was badddd.. We called on New Year's Eve to see if it was open and they didn't answer the first two times and then picked up and hung up on us a few more times. I had to check IG to see if someone posted there recently to see if it was open and it was so we went. We get there over an hour before they close and the hostess said they weren't taking anymore reservations. If they would have picked up the phone and told us they weren't seating people we wouldn't have ubered over there. Place did not appear busy at all...she ended up telling us to go to bar and said to check there for seating. 

Ordered the shrimp and grits and Brussels sprouts and both came out on the cooler side of Luke warm. Taste seemed like it would have been good but couldn't tell because we were eating cool shrimp and grits. Disappointed to say the LEAST.

Came here for old city eats and was so impressed by this place. It has a very unassuming storefront with a tiny deck and some seating and honestly if I didn't know to find it I would regularly just walk past it. Once you walk in, you'll be pleasantly surprised by how expansive the space is and how minimal and hipster the decor is. They have over 30 beers on tap and a pretty decent food menu selection.

We got a chance to try the black truffle Mac and cheese - couldn't really taste the too much truffle tbh but was still a good Mac. Also tried the black squid ink pasta which was made in house and that was very good as well. We were told their menu rotated seasonally and often intra-seasonally. 

Definitely will be going back to try some more of their food and drinks. I think it's a great spot for a casual group dinner and beers, especially if you plan on going out in old city after.

I live right down the street. This place used to have great service and food, but something has changed over the past several months. The last handful of times I have been, the service has been slack, orders wrong and food has been cold and/or dry by the time it reached my table. Every time. I waited, giving more chances. It's walking distance to my house. I want it to be good. Don't know about other locations. Won't be back.

We have been looking for good Mexican food in Edmonton for almost 3 years now. Today we ordered take-out from Huma. Food was there when I came to pick it up, but we needed to reheat it. Very friendly. Very helpful when it came to asking about my wife's MSG allergy. Greatly appreciate that. My wife had Tacos El Pastor and I had fish tacos. Both were good, but not great. Positions were generous. Prices reasonable for Edmonton. We will likely try them again before forming a final opinion.
